description: NaScHfO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.76 Å. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.15 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-57°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent Hf sites. In the first Hf site, Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-57°. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.12 Å. In the second Hf site, Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.13 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Hf atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Hf atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Hf atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Hf₂Sc square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Hf atom to form distorted ONa₂HfSc₂ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂HfSc₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂Hf₂Sc square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂HfSc₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Hf atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Hf₂Sc trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Hf atom to form distorted ONa₂HfSc₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂HfSc₂ square pyramids, corners with three ONa₂Hf₂Sc trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂HfSc₂ square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂Hf₂Sc trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Hf atoms to form distorted ONa₂Hf₂Sc trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Hf₂Sc square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂Hf₂Sc trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂Hf₂Sc square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂HfSc₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Hf atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂HfSc₂ trigonal bipyramids.
